questions.question:
**Select the option that is the passive form of the given sentence.**

The Principal gave her a warning about coming late to school every day.

options.text: She was giving a warning by the Principal about coming late to school every day.
She has given a warning by the Principal about coming late to school every day.
She gives a warning to the Principal about coming late to school every day.
She was given a warning about coming late to school every day by the Principal.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'She was given a warning about coming late to school every day by the Principal.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **Active Voice. **As per the question we have to change it into** Passive Voice**. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• **The subject** of the given sentence is **'The Principal'. **
 
• The object of the given sentence is **'Her'.**
 
• ** The subject will be put in the place of the object and the object will be put in the place of the subject **in the converted sentence.
 
• **'Gave'** will be changed into **'was given'. **
 
• The remaining sentence will be written as it is. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4. **

 

**Correct Answer:__** *She was given a warning about coming late to school every day by the Principal. *

questions.question:
**Select the option that is the direct form of the given sentence.**

The child asked his mother if he could swim in the pool there.

options.text: The child asked his mother, “Could he swim in the pool there?”
The child asked his mother, “Can I swim in the pool here?”
The child asked to his mother, “Can he swim in the pool there?”
The child said to his mother, “Will I swim in the pool here?”

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The child asked his mother, “Can I swim in the pool here?”. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in** Indirect Speech.** As per the question we have to change it into **Direct Speech. **
 
• The process of transformation as follows:
 
 
• **'Asked'** should be changed into** 'said to'. But due to options we will not change 'asked'. **
 
• **Comma and Inverted commas** will be added. 
 
• **'He'** will be changed into** 'I'. **
 
• **'There' **will be changed into **'here'. **
 
• We know that** 'can' **is changed into **'could'. **Hence,** 'can'** will be used. Only **Option 2 and 4** have the correct subject **'I'. **
 
• Option 4 is wrong because the helping verb used in Option 4 is incorrect. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.** 

 

**Correct Answer:__** *The child asked his mother, “Can I swim in the pool here?” *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea728f908b060e4db8cdc0f37188bd8bacc49aff99cc89b07517095538ec56de.png] 

 
• Seeing '**can**' we tend to mark** Option 3** but it would be wrong because **the subject used here is incorrect. **
 
• Therefore, **Option 2** is the correct answer.

questions.question:

A. So, clearly, where you get your news from matters since you can’t possibly be expected to verify and authenticate every bit of ‘news’ you receive.

C. Yet, we do often forward these in the belief that we are doing a good deed to our friends and relatives.

D. Being educated is no guarantee against falling prey to fake news.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**DBCA**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Only **Part D** can be the first sentence because **the first statement of a sentence jumble question is usually a general statement, noun, a universal fact, or starting of an incident, etc. **
 
• Here, **Part D** is **a general statement. **
 
• **Part B and Part C are connected with each other. Part B is followed by Part C.**
 
• Lastly, **Part A** will be used. 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Answer:__** *DBCA. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **We also know that 'May and Might' do not take 'Possibly' and 'Likely' with it.**
 
• It makes the sentence **superfluous.** 
 
• Its example as follows: 
 
 
• *We **may possibly **come tomorrow. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
• *We **may** come tomorrow. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] *

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

There is a double-digit growth in salaries of vocational jobs now and the trend __are likely to continue__ in the coming years.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**is likely to continue**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence needs improvement. The correct answer is **Option 4.**
 
• **In a sentence Helping Verb should be according to the main subject of the sentence.**
 
• In the given sentence the main subject is **'the trend'.** **This is a singular subject.**
 
• Therefore, **a singular verb** should be used instead of** a plural subject. **

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *There is a double-digit growth in salaries of vocational jobs now and the trend __**is likely to continue**__ in the coming years. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When two subjects are connected with** 'as well as, with, along with, together with, in addition to, except, rather than, accompanied by, nothing but, etc.',** then the helping verb should be used according to the first subject of the sentence.
 
• Example:
 
 
• The Captain along with the sailors were drowned. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
• The Captain along with the sailors was drowned. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] *

questions.question:

Relating to the healing of diseases
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Therapeutic**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer to the given One Word is '**Therapeutic**'.
 
• **Therapeutic: causing someone to feel happier and more relaxed or to be more healthy**
 
 
• *Example: I find gardening very **therapeutic.***
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Answer:__** *Therapeutic.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The meaning of the other words given in the option as follows:
 
• **Immunity: a situation in which you are protected against disease or from legal action. **
 
 
• *Example: The vaccination gives you **immunity **against the disease for up to six months.*
 
 
 
• **Preventive: intended to stop something before it happens.**
 
 
• *Example: In the past ten years, **preventive** measures have radically reduced levels of tooth decay in children.*
 
 
 
• **Inoculation: to give a weak form of a disease to a person or animal, usually by injection, as a protection against that disease.**
 
 
• *Example: My children have been **inoculated** against polio.*
